posts.trend: IIT, IIM paychecks hit pause as median campus salaries stay flat for Class of 2027
posts.context: Middle-class Indian society views premium degrees as guaranteed, inflation-proof paths to instant wealth.
posts.angle: The neighborhood status system built around placement packages is experiencing a technical glitch.
slides: The Sharma ji beta roadmap has run into a pricing error.

"IIT Bombay gaya tha na?"
"Haan, package toh sunne mein nahi aaya."
"Unka bhi campus placement flat chal raha hai."
"Sharma ji ab capital gains ki baat nahi karte."

The neighborhood ranking system has collapsed.

Nobody knows who is winning anymore.
posts.caption: Name the uncle who hasn't asked about your appraisal since the campus placement reports came out. 🤫
posts.rank_verdict: The humor is sharp but highly reliant on local Indian status symbols, limiting its universal appeal.
